# `features/mentions`

Typing a trigger character suggests entities and inserts them as chips.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Typing a trigger character suggests entities and inserts them as chips.
- **Avoid when:** The field selects one resource up front, or the suggestions are commands.
- **Consider instead:** `features/combobox`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { MentionChip } from "themelia-ui/features/mentions"
import "themelia-ui/features/mentions.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/avatar`, `base/command`, `base/item`, `base/popover`, `base/spinner`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

### `buildMentionHtml`

Kind: callable.

the caret somewhere to land after the chip.

Kind: type.

A chip always carries meaning, so `neutral` is excluded.

```text
Exclude<SemanticTone, "neutral">
```

### `parseMentionsFromHtml`

Kind: callable.

Reads the mentions back out of a body, e.g. so a composer's list shrinks when a chip is
deleted. First occurrence wins. Returns id, kind and label only; merge with known
mentions to keep `href` and `data`.

```text
(html: string) => Array<Mention<TKind>>
```

### `splitHtmlByMentions`

Kind: callable.

Splits a body into HTML runs and mention placeholders, so prose renders as innerHTML and
references as React chips. `fallback` is the stored element, rendered when the record
does not know the mention.

```text
(html: string) => MentionHtmlSegment[]
```

## Preview recipes

Preview route: Mentions — `/mentions`

### Typing a mention

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
const editorRef = useRef<MentionEditorHandle>(null)
const mentions = useMentions<"user" | "booking">({ resources, editorRef })

<div style={{ position: "relative" }}>
  <Editor ref={editorRef} onCaretChange={mentions.handleCaretChange} />
  <MentionInlineSuggestions
    {...mentions}
    open={mentions.triggerActive && mentions.pickerOpen}
    loading={mentions.isLoading}
    onManualKindChange={() => mentions.setManualKindOverride(true)}
    onSelect={mentions.pickSuggestion}
    onDismiss={() => mentions.setPickerOpen(false)}
  />
</div>
```

### Rendering a stored body

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<MentionContent
  html={comment.body}
  mentions={comment.mentions}
  resources={resources}
/>
```

### Chips

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<MentionChip mention={mention} resource={resources[mention.kind]} />
```
